correctness.rationale: The support [0,r], where the invariant acip is equivalent to Lebesgue, makes specified short cylinders positive. Off either locus, a positive transition would force arbitrarily long alternating or all-one cylinders if the process were one-step Markov; an affine expanding map with fixed point strictly to the right of r makes these cylinders eventually empty, uniformly. On each admissible locus, explicitly normalized densities solve the transfer equation and full-atom affine cylinder images prove every conditional transition probability. Rational exact cylinder checks through seven digits supplement, not replace, the all-length proof.

value.rationale: The precise Markov-memory locus is a natural dynamical-coding invariant of the two-parameter greedy double-base family. An exhaustive phase classification sharply separates the interior golden-mean dependent code, the Bernoulli full-branch boundary, and all non-Markov intermediate/off-locus parameters. It supplies exact stationary transition and correlation data, rather than a routine one-parameter special case or isolated finite computation.
